subject: Math
skill: Ratios Rates Proportional Relationships And Units
prompt:
A bottling machine fills bottles at a constant rate of $35$ bottles per minute. At what rate, in bottles per hour, does the machine fill the bottles?

$$0$$

$$2100$$
explanation: The correct answer is $2100$. There are $60$ minutes in one hour. At a rate of $35$ bottles per minute, the number of bottles filled in one hour is $\left( \frac{35 \text{ bottles}}{1 \text{ minute}} \right) \left( \frac{60 \text{ minutes}}{1 \text{ hour}} \right) = 2{,}100$ bottles per hour.
